_review_notes: Tuned under the re-ranking protocol (rerank_pool): policies fit on the runner's full train frame (6594 rows) and re-rank each user's held-out MCAR pool, scored by mean_hit_rate at k=5. This is NOT the ml-1m workflow — see docs/policy_configs.md.

LEAKAGE: hyperparameters were selected on 290 of the 290 users whose labels also form the reference ordering of the re-ranking run. Real utilities of tuned policies are optimistically biased; RandomPolicy and PopularityPolicy have nothing to select and carry no such bias, so a tuned policy overtaking them is partly an artifact of that selection.

Selections still on a grid boundary, i.e. reported at a handicap: LightGCNTorchPolicy iterations=3000 (max of [300, 1000, 3000]), n_factors=4 (min of [4, 8, 16]), n_layers=4 (max of [2, 3, 4]), regularization=0.0001 (min of [0.0001, 0.001, 0.01]). Every edge points the same way — fewer factors, more smoothing — so these policies are degenerating toward popularity on a 290x300 matrix rather than sitting at an interior optimum.
